Just remember: U.S. Stock doesn’t mean you stop asking questions. Confirm your exact item + quantity are actually in the U.S., where they’re shipping from, domestic freight cost and delivery time before paying. Officially placed my first Alibaba order 😅👏🏼 and apparently I’ve learned an entirely new vocabulary in the process. DDP = Delivered Duty Paid. Where is it being delivered? Are duties/tariffs and customs clearance included? Do I need to unload it? What happens if something arrives damaged?  I’m definitely still learning, but I’m sharing the things I have learned to make this process easier for someone else. And now we wait to see if my first order actually makes it to Ohio. 😂🤞🏼#buyfromchina #alibaba #customhome #BuildingAHouse #homebuildingtips

Masayoshi Son’s $20 million bet on Alibaba became one of the greatest venture capital investments in history. 💰 In 2000, Son met a relatively unknown Jack Ma and reportedly spent only a few minutes with him before deciding to invest. Instead of relying entirely on financial projections, Son believed in Ma’s vision and the potential of his company. SoftBank eventually secured roughly a 30% stake in Alibaba. What started as a $20 million investment later became worth billions as Alibaba grew into one of the world’s biggest technology companies. Interestingly, Son initially wanted to invest $40 million, but Jack Ma reportedly accepted only $20 million because he believed that was enough to build the business. The lesson? Sometimes the biggest investments are made before the numbers look obvious. Would you invest based on a founder’s vision—or wait for the financial data to prove it?
